obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your case file

results.segment: Your appointment about your case file with Grantley Legal Aid is booked for 1 March 2027 at 5.30pm.

Please complete the enclosed questionnaire and hand it in when you come in.

Please have your account number written down before you attend.
If the date no longer suits you, our reception team can offer another.
Your booking on 3 September was cancelled by us and refunded in full.
